nodes.name: Sanitize and Normalize Failure
nodes.notes: Creates a stable run identifier and strips common secret formats. It intentionally does not persist the failed input or stack trace.

parameters.subject: =[n8n failure] {{ $('Sanitize and Normalize Failure').item.json.workflow_key }} / {{ $('Sanitize and Normalize Failure').item.json.run_id }}

nodes.name: Send Failure Alert
nodes.notes: Bind a Gmail credential and replace the recipient after import. Credential IDs are intentionally omitted.
